svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json title: Streaming analytics on Google Cloud subtitle: Events flow through Pub/Sub and Dataflow into BigQuery for Looker dashboards and Vertex AI models direction: down # One port per edge: the two publish edges and Dataflow's three outputs each keep their own arrowhead. layout: { merge: false } legend: solid: Data flow dotted: Training data groups: sources: { type: gcp:external, label: Event sources } gcloud: { type: gcp:cloud } project: { type: gcp:project, label: Project analytics-prod, in: gcloud } nodes: devices: { icon: generic:iot, label: Store devices, in: sources } apps: { icon: generic:mobile, label: Web and mobile apps, in: sources } topic: { icon: gcp:pubsub, label: Pub/Sub, note: events topic, in: project } # Beside the topic (align), so ingestion reads across one row and the outputs fan out below. pipeline: { icon: gcp:dataflow, label: Dataflow, note: Streaming pipeline, in: project, align: topic } archive: { icon: gcp:cloud-storage, label: Cloud Storage, note: Raw event archive, in: project } warehouse: { icon: gcp:bigquery, label: BigQuery, note: Analytics tables, in: project } model: { icon: gcp:vertex-ai, label: Vertex AI, note: Demand forecast model, in: project } dashboards: { icon: gcp:looker, label: Looker, note: Sales dashboards, in: project } edges: - devices, apps -> topic: publish - topic -> pipeline: subscribe - pipeline -> warehouse: events and scores - pipeline -> archive: raw files - pipeline -> model: online prediction - warehouse -> dashboards: SQL - warehouse ..> model: training data

svg.title: Streaming analytics on Google Cloud
svg.desc: Streaming analytics on Google Cloud. 8 components in 3 groups. Connections: Store devices to Pub/Sub (publish); Web and mobile apps to Pub/Sub (publish); Pub/Sub to Dataflow (subscribe); Dataflow to BigQuery (events and scores); Dataflow to Cloud Storage (raw files); Dataflow to Vertex AI (online prediction); BigQuery to Looker (SQL); BigQuery to Vertex AI (training data).

text.tspan: Events flow through Pub/Sub and Dataflow into BigQuery for Looker dashboards and Vertex AI
